On this single frozen 140-goal bank, after V3 removes 9 near-copies (app_001, app_021, app_024, app_031, app_041, app_061, app_081, oos_009, oos_028), max-cosine selection over the 20 frozen intent embeddings attains mechanism-identity accuracy 86/93=0.9247 on the 93-goal primary set and strictly exceeds the frozen token-set-Jaccard comparator (49/93=0.5269); the paired family-blocked 95% bootstrap interval is [0.2967,0.4947], entirely above zero (B=10000, alpha=0.05, 5 resource families, seed 3806477323).
